rows.title: Accepted Students Day
rows.summary: Campus visit day for admitted students centered on Warren Wilson’s experiential learning model, blending liberal arts with community engagement and on campus work. Expect info sessions, student connections, and a guided look at campus life in Canon Lounge.
rows.description: Join us on March 28th for an unforgettable day of exploration and connection, designed exclusively for our admitted students. Experience Warren Wilson’s unique experiential learning model, which blends the liberal arts with community engagement and on-campus work.

rows.title: Sunday Worship Service
rows.summary: Contemplative Presbyterian worship with hymns, prayers, and a brief sermon in Warren Wilson Presbyterian's small chapel; weekly Sunday late-morning gathering welcoming community members and visitors in Swannanoa.
rows.description: Weekly Sunday worship service.

rows.title: Asheville Summer Soccer Watch Party
rows.summary: Big-match soccer viewing with a lively crowd at an urban cider house, with drinks flowing and food available throughout the games. Reserve a spot for prime viewing and a social, late-summer sports-night atmosphere.
rows.description: Come on down to Asheville, North Carolina to watch the big Soccer games! Enjoy Drinks and food and reserve your spot watching the best games

rows.title: Cribbage
rows.summary: Weekly Monday cribbage club meetup with casual card-game play, friendly competition, and regulars who welcome new players. Gather at the American Legion hall in Waynesville for an easygoing community game night.
rows.description: Western North Carolina Cribbage Club meets every Monday.

rows.title: Master of Fine Art Thesis Exhibition 2026
rows.summary: A culminating MFA thesis exhibition with five graduating WCU artists presenting contemporary work across multiple media after three years of studio research and experimentation. Expect a campus-gallery atmosphere with diverse processes and conceptual approaches.
rows.description: Experience the culmination of three years of intense creative study and exploration in this exhibition, highlighting artwork from graduating MFA students at the WCU Belcher College School of Art and Design. This year’s exhibition showcases work in various media by five artists: Holly Hill, Lynne M. Hudson, Reese Seigfried, Brooklin Routt, and Remi Roce.

rows.title: The 58th Juried Undergraduate Exhibition
rows.summary: A juried showcase of Western Carolina University undergraduate artwork, presented in a professional gallery setting for public viewing. Emphasizes student experience in exhibiting and presenting contemporary pieces to a broader community.
rows.description: This exhibition is an extraordinary opportunity for WCU undergraduate students to share their artwork with a larger public and to enhance their skills in presenting artwork in a professional gallery setting.

rows.title: Astrology Club
rows.summary: A casual astrology discussion meetup with drop-in attendance, meeting on the 1st and 3rd Thursdays. Gather at a community center for chart talk, questions, and shared learning in an easygoing group setting.
rows.description: This program will take place the 1st and 3rd Thursdays from 5:30pm – 7:30pm. Drop-ins welcome.

rows.title: Ballroom Dance
rows.summary: Drop-in ballroom night with a short rotating monthly lesson followed by two hours of social dancing in a community center setting. October spotlights tango, with room for beginners and experienced dancers alike.
rows.description: This is a drop-in class where all are welcome: The first portion of the class is comprised of a dance lesson followed by two hours of dancing. The type of ballroom dance rotates each month. Feel free to reach out to the group leader for more information.
